properties.name: 2D6
properties.source_quote: Most of these throws are characteristic throws – roll 2D6, add the DM from the listed characteristic, and try to get a total higher than the listed value.

properties.name: age_of_majority
properties.source_quote: All characters begin at the age of majority, typically 18.

properties.name: Athlete
properties.career_summary: **Athlete:** Individual that has achieved celebrity status for their proficiency in sports and other forms of physical exercise.
properties.source_quote: **Athlete:** Individual that has achieved celebrity status for their proficiency in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

properties.name: Aerospace Defense
properties.career_summary: **Aerospace System Defense:** Member of a planetary armed military force operating within a world's atmosphere and close orbit. Also known as the "planetary air force".
properties.source_quote: **Aerospace System Defense:** Member of a planetary armed military force operating within a world's atmosphere and close orbit. Also known as the "planetary air force".

properties.name: Agent
properties.career_summary: **Agent:** Individual that secretly collects and reports information on the activities, movements and plans of a political or corporate enemy or competitor. Also known as a spy or intelligence operative.
properties.source_quote: **Agent:** Individual that secretly collects and reports information on the activities, movements and plans of a political or corporate enemy or competitor. Also known as a spy or intelligence operative.

properties.name: Barbarian
properties.career_summary: **Barbarian:** Individual from a primitive world (TL4 or less) capable of surviving on their world without support from a technologically advanced civilization.
properties.source_quote: **Barbarian:** Individual from a primitive world (TL4 or less) capable of surviving on their world without support from a technologically advanced civilization.

properties.name: Belter
properties.career_summary: **Belter:** Individual that explores asteroid belts in search of mineral deposits and salvageable material for profit.
properties.source_quote: **Belter:** Individual that explores asteroid belts in search of mineral deposits and salvageable material for profit.

properties.name: Bureaucrat
properties.career_summary: **Bureaucrat:** Official in a government department, charged with following the details of administrative process.
properties.source_quote: **Bureaucrat:** Official in a government department, charged with following the details of administrative process.

properties.name: Colonist
properties.career_summary: **Colonist:** Individual that moves to a new world or settles in a new planetary colony.
properties.source_quote: **Colonist:** Individual that moves to a new world or settles in a new planetary colony.

properties.name: Diplomat
properties.career_summary: **Diplomat:** Individual that is appointed by a planetary or interstellar government to conduct official negotiations and maintain political, economic and social relations with another polity or polities.
properties.source_quote: **Diplomat:** Individual that is appointed by a planetary or interstellar government to conduct official negotiations and maintain political, economic and social relations with another polity or polities.

properties.name: Drifter
properties.career_summary: **Drifter:** Individual that continually moves from place to place, without any fixed home or job.
properties.source_quote: **Drifter:** Individual that continually moves from place to place, without any fixed home or job.

properties.name: Entertainer
properties.career_summary: **Entertainer:** Individual that has achieved celebrity status for their proficiency in publicly entertaining others.
properties.source_quote: **Entertainer:** Individual that has achieved celebrity status for their proficiency in publicly entertaining others.

properties.name: Hunter
properties.career_summary: **Hunter:** Individual that kills or traps large game, almost always large terrestrial mammals, for meat, other animal by-products (such as horn or bone), trophy or sport.
properties.source_quote: **Hunter:** Individual that kills or traps large game, almost always large terrestrial mammals, for meat, other animal by-products (such as horn or bone), trophy or sport.

properties.name: Marine
properties.career_summary: **Marine:** Member of an interstellar armed military force trained to serve in a variety of environments, often carried on board starships as an adjunct to an interstellar navy. Also known as the "space marines".
properties.source_quote: **Marine:** Member of an interstellar armed military force trained to serve in a variety of environments, often carried on board starships as an adjunct to an interstellar navy. Also known as the "space marines".

properties.name: Maritime Defense
properties.career_summary: **Maritime System Defense:** Member of a planetary armed military force operating within and on the surface of a world's oceans. Also known as the "planetary wet navy".
properties.source_quote: **Maritime System Defense:** Member of a planetary armed military force operating within and on the surface of a world's oceans. Also known as the "planetary wet navy".

properties.name: Mercenary
properties.career_summary: **Mercenary:** Professional soldier hired to serve in a foreign military force or perform a specific military action.
properties.source_quote: **Mercenary:** Professional soldier hired to serve in a foreign military force or perform a specific military action.

properties.name: Merchant
properties.career_summary: **Merchant:** Individual involved in wholesale interstellar trade, particularly between individual worlds or polities.
properties.source_quote: **Merchant:** Individual involved in wholesale interstellar trade, particularly between individual worlds or polities.

properties.name: Navy
properties.career_summary: **Navy:** Member of an interstellar armed military force that conducts military operations in interplanetary or interstellar space. Also known as the "space navy".
properties.source_quote: **Navy:** Member of an interstellar armed military force that conducts military operations in interplanetary or interstellar space. Also known as the "space navy".

properties.name: Noble
properties.career_summary: **Noble:** Member of an elite upper class, having high social or political status.
properties.source_quote: **Noble:** Member of an elite upper class, having high social or political status.

properties.name: Physician
properties.career_summary: **Physician:** Individual that is skilled in the science of medicine and is trained and licensed to treat sick and injured people.
properties.source_quote: **Physician:** Individual that is skilled in the science of medicine and is trained and licensed to treat sick and injured people.

properties.name: Pirate
properties.career_summary: **Pirate:** Individual that attacks and steals from interplanetary and interstellar ships in space.
properties.source_quote: **Pirate:** Individual that attacks and steals from interplanetary and interstellar ships in space.

properties.name: Rogue
properties.career_summary: **Rogue:** Individual that makes their living through illicit means.
properties.source_quote: **Rogue:** Individual that makes their living through illicit means.

properties.name: Scientist
properties.career_summary: **Scientist:** Individual that is engaged in and has expert knowledge of a science, especially a biological or physical science.
properties.source_quote: **Scientist:** Individual that is engaged in and has expert knowledge of a science, especially a biological or physical science.

properties.name: Scout
properties.career_summary: **Scout:** Member of an interplanetary exploratory service, surveying unfamiliar territory in space.
properties.source_quote: **Scout:** Member of an interplanetary exploratory service, surveying unfamiliar territory in space.

properties.name: Surface Defense
properties.career_summary: **Surface System Defense:** Member of a planetary armed military force operating on the non-hydrographic surface of a world. Also known as the "planetary army".
properties.source_quote: **Surface System Defense:** Member of a planetary armed military force operating on the non-hydrographic surface of a world. Also known as the "planetary army".

properties.name: Technician
properties.career_summary: **Technician:** Individual that is skilled in mechanical or industrial techniques or in a particular technical field.
properties.source_quote: **Technician:** Individual that is skilled in mechanical or industrial techniques or in a particular technical field.
